listing.name: Reputation Decay
listing.summary: Adds a system where reputation gradually decays over time, with customizable decay rates and minimum values.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a system where reputation gradually decays over time, with customizable decay rates and minimum values.

description:
Download link

A simple mod that makes reputation decay to 0 over time. You can change the rate of the decay (default 1 per month) and whether reputation should decay to 0 at all times, or if it should decay to 75 or -75 if cooperative or vengeful (true by default).

Thanks Jaghaimo and Histidine.

aiDescription: Adds a reputation decay system that reduces reputation to zero over time, with options to adjust the decay rate and set minimum values based on reputation type. The default decay is 1 point per month, and it can decay to 0, 75, or -75 depending on whether the reputation is cooperative, vengeful, or neutral.
